verses.en: having set the priests according to their daily courses, being arrayed in their vestments, in the temple of the Lord.
verses.am: having set the priests according to their daily courses, being arrayed in their vestments, in the temple of the Lord.

verses.en: And he spoke to the Levites, That is, the temple servants. See Num 3:9. the temple-servants of Israel, that they should hallow themselves to the Lord, to set the holy ark of the Lord in the house that King Solomon the son of David had built:
verses.am: And he spoke to the Levites, That is, the temple servants. See Num 3:9. the temple-servants of Israel, that they should hallow themselves to the Lord, to set the holy ark of the Lord in the house that King Solomon the son of David had built:

verses.en: and said, You⌃ shall no more have need to bear it upon your shoulders: now therefore serve the Lord your God, and minister to his people Israel, and prepare you after your fathers’ houses and kindred,
verses.am: and said, You⌃ shall no more have need to bear it upon your shoulders: now therefore serve the Lord your God, and minister to his people Israel, and prepare you after your fathers’ houses and kindred,

verses.en: according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the magnificence of Solomon his son: and standing in the holy place according to the several divisions of the families of you the Levites, who minister in the presence of your kindred the children of Israel,

verses.am: offer the passover in order, and make ready the sacrifices for your kindred, and keep the passover according to the commandment of the Lord, which was given to Moses.

verses.en: And to the people which were present Josias gave thirty thousand lambs and kids, and three thousand calves: these things were given of the king’s substance, according as he promised, to the people, and to the priests and Levites.
verses.am: And to the people which were present Josias gave thirty thousand lambs and kids, and three thousand calves: these things were given of the king’s substance, according as he promised, to the people, and to the priests and Levites.

verses.en: And Helkias, and Zacharias, and Jehiel, 2 Chronicles 35:8. Esyelus, the rulers of the temple, gave to the priests for the passover two thousand and six hundred sheep, and three hundred calves.
verses.am: And Helkias, and Zacharias, and Jehiel, 2 Chronicles 35:8. Esyelus, the rulers of the temple, gave to the priests for the passover two thousand and six hundred sheep, and three hundred calves.

verses.en: And Jeconias, and Samaias and Nathanael his brother, and Sabias, and Ochielus, and Joram, captains over thousands, gave to the Levites for the passover five thousand sheep, and seven hundred calves.
verses.am: And Jeconias, and Samaias and Nathanael his brother, and Sabias, and Ochielus, and Joram, captains over thousands, gave to the Levites for the passover five thousand sheep, and seven hundred calves.

verses.en: And when these things were done, the priests and Levites, having the unleavened bread, stood in comely order according to the kindred,
verses.am: And when these things were done, the priests and Levites, having the unleavened bread, stood in comely order according to the kindred,

verses.en: and according to the several divisions by fathers’ houses, before the people, to offer to the Lord, as it is written in the book of Moses: and thus did they in the morning.
verses.am: and according to the several divisions by fathers’ houses, before the people, to offer to the Lord, as it is written in the book of Moses: and thus did they in the morning.

verses.en: And they roasted the passover with fire, as appertains: and the sacrifices they sod in the brazen vessels and caldrons with a good savor,
verses.am: And they roasted the passover with fire, as appertains: and the sacrifices they sod in the brazen vessels and caldrons with a good savor,

verses.en: and set them before all the people: and afterward they prepared for themselves, and for the priests their kindred, the sons of Aaron.
verses.am: and set them before all the people: and afterward they prepared for themselves, and for the priests their kindred, the sons of Aaron.

verses.en: For the priests offered the fat until night: and the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests their kindred, the sons of Aaron.
verses.am: For the priests offered the fat until night: and the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests their kindred, the sons of Aaron.

verses.en: The holy singers also, the sons of Asaph, were in their order, according to the appointment of David, to wit, Asaph, Zacharias, and Eddinus, who Another reading is, were. was of the king’s retinue.
verses.am: The holy singers also, the sons of Asaph, were in their order, according to the appointment of David, to wit, Asaph, Zacharias, and Eddinus, who Another reading is, were. was of the king’s retinue.

verses.en: Moreover the gatekeepers were at every gate; none had need to depart from his daily course: for their kindred the Levites prepared for them.
verses.am: Moreover the gatekeepers were at every gate; none had need to depart from his daily course: for their kindred the Levites prepared for them.

verses.en: Thus were the things that belonged to the sacrifices of the Lord accomplished in that day, in holding the passover,
verses.am: Thus were the things that belonged to the sacrifices of the Lord accomplished in that day, in holding the passover,

verses.en: and offering sacrifices upon the altar of the Lord, according to the commandment of King Josias.
verses.am: and offering sacrifices upon the altar of the Lord, according to the commandment of King Josias.

verses.en: So the children of Israel which were present at that time held the passover, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.
verses.am: So the children of Israel which were present at that time held the passover, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

verses.en: And such a passover was not held in Israel since the time of the prophet Samuel.
verses.am: And such a passover was not held in Israel since the time of the prophet Samuel.

verses.en: Yes, all the kings of Israel held not such a passover as Josias, and the priests, and the Levites, and the Jews, held with all Israel that were present in their dwelling place at Jerusalem.
verses.am: Yes, all the kings of Israel held not such a passover as Josias, and the priests, and the Levites, and the Jews, held with all Israel that were present in their dwelling place at Jerusalem.

verses.en: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josias was this passover held.
verses.am: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josias was this passover held.

verses.en: And the works of Josias were upright before his Lord with a heart full of godliness.
verses.am: And the works of Josias were upright before his Lord with a heart full of godliness.

verses.en: Moreover the things that came to pass in his days have been written in times past, concerning those that sinned, and did wickedly against the Lord above every people and kingdom, and how they grieved him Or, sensibly Judges 16:17. exceedingly, so that the words of the Lord were confirmed against Israel.
verses.am: Moreover the things that came to pass in his days have been written in times past, concerning those that sinned, and did wickedly against the Lord above every people and kingdom, and how they grieved him Or, sensibly Judges 16:17. exceedingly, so that the words of the Lord were confirmed against Israel.

verses.en: 2 Chronicles 35:20, etc. Now after all these acts of Josias it came to pass, that Pharaoh the king of Egypt came to raise war at Carchemish upon Euphrates: and Josias went out against him.
verses.am: 2 Chronicles 35:20, etc. Now after all these acts of Josias it came to pass, that Pharaoh the king of Egypt came to raise war at Carchemish upon Euphrates: and Josias went out against him.

verses.en: But the king of Egypt sent to him, saying, What have I to do with you, O king of Judea?
verses.am: But the king of Egypt sent to him, saying, What have I to do with you, O king of Judea?

verses.en: I am not sent out from the Lord God against you; for my war is upon Euphrates: and now the Lord is with me, yes, the Lord is with me hasting me forward: depart from me, and be not against the Lord.
verses.am: I am not sent out from the Lord God against you; for my war is upon Euphrates: and now the Lord is with me, yes, the Lord is with me hasting me forward: depart from me, and be not against the Lord.

verses.en: Howbeit Josias did not turn back Another reading is, his chariot from him. to his chariot, but undertook to fight with him, not regarding the words of the prophet Jeremy spoken by the mouth of the Lord:
verses.am: Howbeit Josias did not turn back Another reading is, his chariot from him. to his chariot, but undertook to fight with him, not regarding the words of the prophet Jeremy spoken by the mouth of the Lord:

verses.en: but joined battle with him in the plain of Megiddo, and the princes came down against King Josias.
verses.am: but joined battle with him in the plain of Megiddo, and the princes came down against King Josias.

verses.en: Then said the king to his servants, Carry me away out of the battle; for I am very weak. And immediately his servants carried him away out of the army.
verses.am: Then said the king to his servants, Carry me away out of the battle; for I am very weak. And immediately his servants carried him away out of the army.

verses.en: Then got he up upon his second chariot; and being brought back to Jerusalem he died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his fathers.
verses.am: Then got he up upon his second chariot; and being brought back to Jerusalem he died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his fathers.

verses.en: And in all Jewry they mourned for Josias; and Jeremy the prophet lamented for Josias, and the chief men with the women made lamentation for him, to this day: and this was given out for an ordinance to be done continually in all the nation of Israel.
verses.am: And in all Jewry they mourned for Josias; and Jeremy the prophet lamented for Josias, and the chief men with the women made lamentation for him, to this day: and this was given out for an ordinance to be done continually in all the nation of Israel.

verses.en: These things are written in the book of the histories of the kings of Judea, and every one of the acts that Josias did, and his glory, and his understanding in the law of the Lord, and the things that he had done before, and the things now recited, are reported in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
verses.am: These things are written in the book of the histories of the kings of Judea, and every one of the acts that Josias did, and his glory, and his understanding in the law of the Lord, and the things that he had done before, and the things now recited, are reported in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

verses.en: 2 Kings23:30; 2 Chronicles 36:1. And the people took Another reading is, Jeconias. Joachaz the son of Josias, and made him king instead of Josias his father, when he was twenty and three years old.
verses.am: 2 Kings23:30; 2 Chronicles 36:1. And the people took Another reading is, Jeconias. Joachaz the son of Josias, and made him king instead of Josias his father, when he was twenty and three years old.

verses.en: And he reigned in Another reading is, Israel. Judah and in Jerusalem three months: and then the king of Egypt deposed him from reigning in Jerusalem.
verses.am: And he reigned in Another reading is, Israel. Judah and in Jerusalem three months: and then the king of Egypt deposed him from reigning in Jerusalem.

verses.en: And he set a tax upon the people of a hundred talents of silver and one talent of gold.
verses.am: And he set a tax upon the people of a hundred talents of silver and one talent of gold.

verses.en: The king of Egypt also made King Joakim his brother king of Judea and Jerusalem.
verses.am: The king of Egypt also made King Joakim his brother king of Judea and Jerusalem.

verses.en: And Joakim bound the nobles: but Zarakes his brother he apprehended, and brought him up out of Egypt.
verses.am: And Joakim bound the nobles: but Zarakes his brother he apprehended, and brought him up out of Egypt.

verses.en: Five and twenty years old was 2 Chronicles 36:4, 5. Joakim when he began to reign in Judea and Jerusalem; and he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.am: Five and twenty years old was 2 Chronicles 36:4, 5. Joakim when he began to reign in Judea and Jerusalem; and he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord.

verses.en: And against him Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon came up, and bound him with a chain of brass, and carried him to Babylon.
verses.am: And against him Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon came up, and bound him with a chain of brass, and carried him to Babylon.

verses.en: Nabuchodonosor also took of the holy vessels of the Lord, and carried them away, and set them up in his own temple at Babylon.
verses.am: Nabuchodonosor also took of the holy vessels of the Lord, and carried them away, and set them up in his own temple at Babylon.

verses.en: But those things that are reported of him, and of his uncleanness and impiety, are written in the chronicles of the kings.
verses.am: But those things that are reported of him, and of his uncleanness and impiety, are written in the chronicles of the kings.

verses.en: And Joakim his son reigned in his stead: for when he was made king he was Another reading is, eight. eighteen years old;
verses.am: And Joakim his son reigned in his stead: for when he was made king he was Another reading is, eight. eighteen years old;

verses.en: and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem; and did that which was evil before the Lord.
verses.am: and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem; and did that which was evil before the Lord.

verses.en: So after a year Nabuchodonosor sent and caused him to be brought to Babylon with the holy vessels of the Lord;
verses.am: So after a year Nabuchodonosor sent and caused him to be brought to Babylon with the holy vessels of the Lord;

verses.en: and made Sedekias king of Judea and Jerusalem, when he was one and twenty years old; and he reigned eleven years:
verses.am: and made Sedekias king of Judea and Jerusalem, when he was one and twenty years old; and he reigned eleven years:

verses.en: and he also did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, and cared not for the words that were spoken by Jeremy the prophet from the mouth of the Lord.
verses.am: and he also did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, and cared not for the words that were spoken by Jeremy the prophet from the mouth of the Lord.

verses.en: And after that king Nabuchodonosor had made him to swear by the name of the Lord, he forswore himself, and rebelled; and hardening his neck, and his heart, he transgressed the laws of the Lord, the God of Israel.
verses.am: And after that king Nabuchodonosor had made him to swear by the name of the Lord, he forswore himself, and rebelled; and hardening his neck, and his heart, he transgressed the laws of the Lord, the God of Israel.

verses.en: Moreover the governors of the people and of the priests did many things wickedly, Another reading is, even above all. and passed all the pollutions of all nations, and defiled the temple of the Lord, which was sanctified in Jerusalem.
verses.am: Moreover the governors of the people and of the priests did many things wickedly, Another reading is, even above all. and passed all the pollutions of all nations, and defiled the temple of the Lord, which was sanctified in Jerusalem.

verses.en: And the God of their fathers sent by his messenger to call them back, because he had compassion on them and on his dwelling place.
verses.am: And the God of their fathers sent by his messenger to call them back, because he had compassion on them and on his dwelling place.

verses.en: But they mocked his messengers; and in the day when the Lord spoke to them, they scoffed at his prophets:
verses.am: But they mocked his messengers; and in the day when the Lord spoke to them, they scoffed at his prophets:

verses.en: so far forth, that he, being angry with his people for their great ungodliness, commanded to bring up the kings of the Chaldeans against them;
verses.am: so far forth, that he, being angry with his people for their great ungodliness, commanded to bring up the kings of the Chaldeans against them;

verses.en: who killed their young men with the sword, round about their holy temple, and spared neither young man nor maid, old man nor child; but he delivered all into their hands.
verses.am: who killed their young men with the sword, round about their holy temple, and spared neither young man nor maid, old man nor child; but he delivered all into their hands.

verses.en: And they took all the holy vessels of the Lord, both great and small, with Another reading is, the arks of the Lord. the vessels of the ark of the Lord, and the king’s treasures, and carried them away to Babylon.
verses.am: And they took all the holy vessels of the Lord, both great and small, with Another reading is, the arks of the Lord. the vessels of the ark of the Lord, and the king’s treasures, and carried them away to Babylon.

verses.en: And they burned the house of the Lord, and brake down the walls of Jerusalem, and burned the towers thereof with fire:
verses.am: And they burned the house of the Lord, and brake down the walls of Jerusalem, and burned the towers thereof with fire:

verses.en: and as for her glorious things, they never ceased till they had brought them all to nothing: and the people that were not slain with the sword he carried to Babylon:
verses.am: and as for her glorious things, they never ceased till they had brought them all to nothing: and the people that were not slain with the sword he carried to Babylon:

verses.en: and they were servants to him and to his children, till the Persians reigned, to fulfil the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremy:
verses.am: and they were servants to him and to his children, till the Persians reigned, to fulfil the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremy:

verses.en: Until the land has enjoyed her Sabbaths, the whole time of her desolation shall she keep Sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.
verses.am: Until the land has enjoyed her Sabbaths, the whole time of her desolation shall she keep Sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.

verses.en: In the 2 Chronicles 36:22, 23; Ezra 1:1, etc. first year of Cyrus king of the Persians, that the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremy might be accomplished,
verses.am: In the 2 Chronicles 36:22, 23; Ezra 1:1, etc. first year of Cyrus king of the Persians, that the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremy might be accomplished,

verses.en: the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of the Persians, and he made proclamation through all his kingdom, and also by writing,
verses.am: the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of the Persians, and he made proclamation through all his kingdom, and also by writing,

verses.en: saying, Thus says Cyrus king of the Persians; The Lord of Israel, the Most High Lord, has made me king of the whole world,
verses.am: saying, Thus says Cyrus king of the Persians; The Lord of Israel, the Most High Lord, has made me king of the whole world,

verses.en: and commanded me to build him a house at Jerusalem that is in Judea.
verses.am: and commanded me to build him a house at Jerusalem that is in Judea.

verses.en: If therefore there be any of you that are of his people, Another reading is, Let his Lord be etc. let the Lord, even his Lord, be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem that is in Judea, and build the house of the Lord of Israel: he is the Lord that dwells in Jerusalem.
verses.am: If therefore there be any of you that are of his people, Another reading is, Let his Lord be etc. let the Lord, even his Lord, be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem that is in Judea, and build the house of the Lord of Israel: he is the Lord that dwells in Jerusalem.

verses.en: Of such therefore as dwell in various places, let those who are in his own place help each one with gold, and with silver,
verses.am: Of such therefore as dwell in various places, let those who are in his own place help each one with gold, and with silver,

verses.en: with gifts, with horses also and cattle, beside the other things which have been added by vow for the temple of the Lord which is in Jerusalem.
verses.am: with gifts, with horses also and cattle, beside the other things which have been added by vow for the temple of the Lord which is in Jerusalem.

verses.en: Then the chief of the families of Judah and of the tribe of Benjamin stood up; the priests also, and the Levites, and all they whose spirit the Lord had stirred to go up, to build the house for the Lord which is in Jerusalem.
verses.am: Then the chief of the families of Judah and of the tribe of Benjamin stood up; the priests also, and the Levites, and all they whose spirit the Lord had stirred to go up, to build the house for the Lord which is in Jerusalem.

verses.en: And those who lived round about them helped them in all things with silver and gold, with horses and cattle, and with very many gifts that were vowed of a great number whose minds were stirred up thereto.
verses.am: And those who lived round about them helped them in all things with silver and gold, with horses and cattle, and with very many gifts that were vowed of a great number whose minds were stirred up thereto.

verses.en: King Cyrus also brought forth the holy vessels of the Lord, which Nabuchodonosor had carried away from Jerusalem, and had set up in his temple of idols.
verses.am: King Cyrus also brought forth the holy vessels of the Lord, which Nabuchodonosor had carried away from Jerusalem, and had set up in his temple of idols.

verses.en: Now when Cyrus king of the Persians had brought them forth, he delivered them to Mithradates his treasurer,
verses.am: Now when Cyrus king of the Persians had brought them forth, he delivered them to Mithradates his treasurer,

verses.en: and by him they were delivered to Another reading is, Simanassar. Sanabassar the governor of Judea.
verses.am: and by him they were delivered to Another reading is, Simanassar. Sanabassar the governor of Judea.

verses.en: And this was the number of them: A thousand golden cups, a thousand cups of silver, censers of silver twenty nine, vials of gold thirty, and of silver two thousand four hundred and ten, and other vessels a thousand.
verses.am: And this was the number of them: A thousand golden cups, a thousand cups of silver, censers of silver twenty nine, vials of gold thirty, and of silver two thousand four hundred and ten, and other vessels a thousand.

verses.en: So all the vessels of gold and of silver were brought up, even five thousand four hundred threescore and nine,
verses.am: So all the vessels of gold and of silver were brought up, even five thousand four hundred threescore and nine,

verses.en: and were carried back by Sanabassar, together with them of the captivity, from Babylon to Jerusalem.
verses.am: and were carried back by Sanabassar, together with them of the captivity, from Babylon to Jerusalem.

verses.en: Ezra 4:7. But in the time of Artaxerxes king of the Persians Belemus, and Mithradates, and Tabellius, and Rehum, Rathumus, and Beeltethmus, and Shimshai. Samellius the scribe, with the others that were in commission with them, dwelling in Samaria and other places, wrote to him against those who lived in Judea and Jerusalem the letter following:
verses.am: Ezra 4:7. But in the time of Artaxerxes king of the Persians Belemus, and Mithradates, and Tabellius, and Rehum, Rathumus, and Beeltethmus, and Shimshai. Samellius the scribe, with the others that were in commission with them, dwelling in Samaria and other places, wrote to him against those who lived in Judea and Jerusalem the letter following:

verses.en: To king Artaxerxes our Lord, Your servants, Rathumus the Or, recorder storywriter, and Samellius the scribe, and the rest of their council, and the judges that are in Coelesyria and Phoenicia.
verses.am: To king Artaxerxes our Lord, Your servants, Rathumus the Or, recorder storywriter, and Samellius the scribe, and the rest of their council, and the judges that are in Coelesyria and Phoenicia.

verses.en: Be it now known to our lord the king, that the Jews that are come up from you to us, being come to Jerusalem, do build that rebellious and wicked city, and do repair the marketplaces and the walls of it, and do lay the foundation of a temple.
verses.am: Be it now known to our lord the king, that the Jews that are come up from you to us, being come to Jerusalem, do build that rebellious and wicked city, and do repair the marketplaces and the walls of it, and do lay the foundation of a temple.

verses.en: Now if this city be built and the walls thereof be finished, they will not only refuse to give tribute, but will even stand up against kings.
verses.am: Now if this city be built and the walls thereof be finished, they will not only refuse to give tribute, but will even stand up against kings.

verses.en: And forasmuch as the things pertaining to the temple are now in hand, we think it meet not to neglect such a matter,
verses.am: And forasmuch as the things pertaining to the temple are now in hand, we think it meet not to neglect such a matter,

verses.en: but to speak to our lord the king, to the intent that, if it be your pleasure, search may be made in the books of your fathers:
verses.am: but to speak to our lord the king, to the intent that, if it be your pleasure, search may be made in the books of your fathers:

verses.en: and you shall find in the chronicles what is written concerning these things, and shall understand that that city was rebellious, troubling both kings and cities:
verses.am: and you shall find in the chronicles what is written concerning these things, and shall understand that that city was rebellious, troubling both kings and cities:

verses.en: and that the Jews were rebellious, and raised always wars therein of old time; for the which cause even this city was laid waste.
verses.am: and that the Jews were rebellious, and raised always wars therein of old time; for the which cause even this city was laid waste.

verses.en: Wherefore now we do declare to you, O lord the king, that if this city be built again, and the walls thereof set up anew, you shall from henceforth have no passage into Coelesyria and Phoenicia.
verses.am: Wherefore now we do declare to you, O lord the king, that if this city be built again, and the walls thereof set up anew, you shall from henceforth have no passage into Coelesyria and Phoenicia.

verses.en: Then the king wrote back again to Rathumus the storywriter, and Beeltethmus, and Samellius the scribe, and to the rest that were in commission, and lived in Samaria and Syria and Phoenicia, after this manner:
verses.am: Then the king wrote back again to Rathumus the storywriter, and Beeltethmus, and Samellius the scribe, and to the rest that were in commission, and lived in Samaria and Syria and Phoenicia, after this manner:

verses.en: I have read the epistle which you⌃ have sent to me: therefore I commanded to make search, and it has been found that that city of old time has made insurrection against kings;
verses.am: I have read the epistle which you⌃ have sent to me: therefore I commanded to make search, and it has been found that that city of old time has made insurrection against kings;

verses.en: and the men were given to rebellion and war therein: and that mighty kings and fierce were in Jerusalem, who reigned and exacted tribute in Coelesyria and Phoenicia.
verses.am: and the men were given to rebellion and war therein: and that mighty kings and fierce were in Jerusalem, who reigned and exacted tribute in Coelesyria and Phoenicia.

verses.en: Now therefore I have commanded to hinder those men from building the city, and heed to be taken that there be nothing done contrary to this order;
verses.am: Now therefore I have commanded to hinder those men from building the city, and heed to be taken that there be nothing done contrary to this order;

verses.en: and that those wicked doings proceed no further to the annoyance of kings.
verses.am: and that those wicked doings proceed no further to the annoyance of kings.

verses.en: Then king Artaxerxes his letters being read, Rathumus, and Samellius the scribe, and the rest that were in commission with them, removing in haste to Jerusalem with horsemen and a multitude of people in battle array, began to hinder the builders; and the building of the temple in Jerusalem ceased until the second year of the reign of Darius king of the Persians.
verses.am: Then king Artaxerxes his letters being read, Rathumus, and Samellius the scribe, and the rest that were in commission with them, removing in haste to Jerusalem with horsemen and a multitude of people in battle array, began to hinder the builders; and the building of the temple in Jerusalem ceased until the second year of the reign of Darius king of the Persians.

verses.en: Now king Darius made a great feast to all his subjects, and to all that were born in his house, and to all the princes of Media and of Persia,
verses.am: Now king Darius made a great feast to all his subjects, and to all that were born in his house, and to all the princes of Media and of Persia,

verses.en: and to all the satraps and captains and governors that were under him, from India to Ethiopia, in the hundred twenty and seven provinces.
verses.am: and to all the satraps and captains and governors that were under him, from India to Ethiopia, in the hundred twenty and seven provinces.

verses.en: And when they had eaten and drunken, and being satisfied were gone home, then Darius the king went into his bedchamber, and slept, and awaked out of his sleep.
verses.am: And when they had eaten and drunken, and being satisfied were gone home, then Darius the king went into his bedchamber, and slept, and awaked out of his sleep.

verses.en: Then the three young men of the body-guard, that kept the king’s person, spoke one to another:
verses.am: Then the three young men of the body-guard, that kept the king’s person, spoke one to another:

verses.en: Let every one of us say one thing which shall be strongest: and he whose sentence shall seem wiser than the others, to him shall Darius the king give great gifts, and great honors in token of victory:
verses.am: Let every one of us say one thing which shall be strongest: and he whose sentence shall seem wiser than the others, to him shall Darius the king give great gifts, and great honors in token of victory:

verses.en: as, to be clothed in purple, to drink in gold, and to sleep upon gold, and a chariot with bridles of gold, and a headtire of fine linen, and a chain about his neck:
verses.am: as, to be clothed in purple, to drink in gold, and to sleep upon gold, and a chariot with bridles of gold, and a headtire of fine linen, and a chain about his neck:

verses.en: and he shall sit next to Darius because of his wisdom, and shall be called Darius his cousin.
verses.am: and he shall sit next to Darius because of his wisdom, and shall be called Darius his cousin.

verses.en: And then they wrote every one his sentence, and set to their seals, and laid the writing under king Darius his pillow,
verses.am: And then they wrote every one his sentence, and set to their seals, and laid the writing under king Darius his pillow,

verses.en: and said, When the king is risen, some shall give him the writing; and of whose side the king and the three princes of Persia shall judge that his sentence is the wisest, to him shall the victory be given, as it is written.
verses.am: and said, When the king is risen, some shall give him the writing; and of whose side the king and the three princes of Persia shall judge that his sentence is the wisest, to him shall the victory be given, as it is written.

verses.en: The first wrote, Wine is the strongest.
verses.am: The first wrote, Wine is the strongest.

verses.en: The second wrote, The king is strongest.
verses.am: The second wrote, The king is strongest.

verses.en: The third wrote, Women are strongest: but above all things Truth bears away the victory.
verses.am: The third wrote, Women are strongest: but above all things Truth bears away the victory.

verses.en: Now when the king was risen up, they took the writing, and gave it to him, and so he read it:
verses.am: Now when the king was risen up, they took the writing, and gave it to him, and so he read it:

verses.en: and sending forth he called all the princes of Persia and of Media, and the satraps, and the captains, and the governors, and the chief officers;
verses.am: and sending forth he called all the princes of Persia and of Media, and the satraps, and the captains, and the governors, and the chief officers;

verses.en: and sat him down in the royal seat of judgment; and the writing was read before them.
verses.am: and sat him down in the royal seat of judgment; and the writing was read before them.

verses.en: And he said, Call the young men, and they shall explain their own sentences. So they were called, and came in.
verses.am: And he said, Call the young men, and they shall explain their own sentences. So they were called, and came in.

verses.en: And they said to them, Declare to us your mind concerning the things you⌃ have written. Then began the first, who had spoken of the strength of wine,
verses.am: And they said to them, Declare to us your mind concerning the things you⌃ have written. Then began the first, who had spoken of the strength of wine,

verses.en: and said thus, O sirs, how exceeding strong is wine! it causes all men to err that drink it:
verses.am: and said thus, O sirs, how exceeding strong is wine! it causes all men to err that drink it:

verses.en: it makes the mind of the king and of the fatherless child to be all one; of the bondman and of the freeman, of the poor man and of the rich:
verses.am: it makes the mind of the king and of the fatherless child to be all one; of the bondman and of the freeman, of the poor man and of the rich:

verses.en: it turns also every thought into jollity and mirth, so that a man remembers neither sorrow nor debt:
verses.am: it turns also every thought into jollity and mirth, so that a man remembers neither sorrow nor debt:

verses.en: and it makes every heart rich, so that a man remembers neither king nor satrap; and it makes to speak all things by talents:
verses.am: and it makes every heart rich, so that a man remembers neither king nor satrap; and it makes to speak all things by talents:

verses.en: and when they are in their cups, they forget their love both to friends and kindred, and a little after draw their swords:
verses.am: and when they are in their cups, they forget their love both to friends and kindred, and a little after draw their swords:

verses.en: but when they awake from their wine, they remember not what they have done.
verses.am: but when they awake from their wine, they remember not what they have done.

verses.en: O sirs, is not wine the strongest, seeing that it enforces to do thus? And when he had so spoken, he held his peace.
verses.am: O sirs, is not wine the strongest, seeing that it enforces to do thus? And when he had so spoken, he held his peace.

verses.en: Then the second, that had spoken of the strength of the king, began to say,
verses.am: Then the second, that had spoken of the strength of the king, began to say,

verses.en: O sirs, do not men excel in strength, that bear rule over the sea and land, and all things in them?
verses.am: O sirs, do not men excel in strength, that bear rule over the sea and land, and all things in them?

verses.en: But yet is the king stronger: and he is their lord, and has dominion over them; and in whatever he commands them they obey him.
verses.am: But yet is the king stronger: and he is their lord, and has dominion over them; and in whatever he commands them they obey him.

verses.en: If he bid them make war the one against the other, they do it: and if he send them out against the enemies, they go, and overcome mountains, walls, and towers.
verses.am: If he bid them make war the one against the other, they do it: and if he send them out against the enemies, they go, and overcome mountains, walls, and towers.

verses.en: They kill and are slain, and transgress not the king’s commandment: if they get the victory, they bring all to the king, as well the plunder, as all things else.
verses.am: They kill and are slain, and transgress not the king’s commandment: if they get the victory, they bring all to the king, as well the plunder, as all things else.

verses.en: Likewise for those that are no soldiers, and have not to do with wars, but use husbandry, when they have reaped again that which they had sown, they bring it to the king, and compel one another to pay tribute to the king.
verses.am: Likewise for those that are no soldiers, and have not to do with wars, but use husbandry, when they have reaped again that which they had sown, they bring it to the king, and compel one another to pay tribute to the king.

verses.en: And he is Or, one and alone but one man: if he command to kill, they kill; if he command to spare, they spare;
verses.am: And he is Or, one and alone but one man: if he command to kill, they kill; if he command to spare, they spare;

verses.en: if he command to strike, they strike; if he command to make desolate, they make desolate; if he command to build, they build;
verses.am: if he command to strike, they strike; if he command to make desolate, they make desolate; if he command to build, they build;

verses.en: if he command to cut down, they cut down; if he command to plant, they plant.
verses.am: if he command to cut down, they cut down; if he command to plant, they plant.

verses.en: So all his people and his armies obey him: furthermore he lies down, he eats and drinks, and takes his rest:
verses.am: So all his people and his armies obey him: furthermore he lies down, he eats and drinks, and takes his rest:

verses.en: and these keep watch round about him, neither may any one depart, and do his own business, neither disobey they him in anything.
verses.am: and these keep watch round about him, neither may any one depart, and do his own business, neither disobey they him in anything.

verses.en: O sirs, how should not the king be strongest, seeing that in such sort he is obeyed? And he held his peace.
verses.am: O sirs, how should not the king be strongest, seeing that in such sort he is obeyed? And he held his peace.

verses.en: Then the third, who had spoken of women, and of truth, (this was Zorobabel) began to speak.
verses.am: Then the third, who had spoken of women, and of truth, (this was Zorobabel) began to speak.

verses.en: O sirs, is not the king great, and men are many, and wine is strong? who is it then that rules them, or has the lordship over them? are they not women?
verses.am: O sirs, is not the king great, and men are many, and wine is strong? who is it then that rules them, or has the lordship over them? are they not women?

verses.en: Women have borne the king and all the people that bear rule by sea and land.
verses.am: Women have borne the king and all the people that bear rule by sea and land.

verses.en: Even of them came they: and they nourished them up that planted the vineyards, from whence the wine comes.
verses.am: Even of them came they: and they nourished them up that planted the vineyards, from whence the wine comes.

verses.en: These also make garments for men; these bring glory to men; and without women can’t men be.
verses.am: These also make garments for men; these bring glory to men; and without women can’t men be.

verses.en: Yes, and if men have gathered together gold and silver and any other goodly thing, Another reading is, do they not love etc. and see a woman which is comely in favor and beauty,
verses.am: Yes, and if men have gathered together gold and silver and any other goodly thing, Another reading is, do they not love etc. and see a woman which is comely in favor and beauty,

verses.en: they let all those things go, and gape after her, and even with open mouth fix their eyes fast on her; and have all more desire to her than to gold or silver, or any goodly thing whatever.
verses.am: they let all those things go, and gape after her, and even with open mouth fix their eyes fast on her; and have all more desire to her than to gold or silver, or any goodly thing whatever.

verses.en: A man leaves his own father that brought him up, and his own country, and cleaves to his wife.
verses.am: A man leaves his own father that brought him up, and his own country, and cleaves to his wife.

verses.en: And with his wife he ends his days, and remembers neither father, nor mother, nor country.
verses.am: And with his wife he ends his days, and remembers neither father, nor mother, nor country.

verses.en: By this also you⌃ must know that women have dominion over you: do you⌃ not labor and toil, and give and bring all to women?
verses.am: By this also you⌃ must know that women have dominion over you: do you⌃ not labor and toil, and give and bring all to women?

verses.en: Yes, a man takes his sword, and goes forth to make outroads, and to rob and to steal, and to sail upon the sea and upon rivers;
verses.am: Yes, a man takes his sword, and goes forth to make outroads, and to rob and to steal, and to sail upon the sea and upon rivers;

verses.en: and looks upon a lion, and walks in the darkness; and when he has stolen, plundered, and robbed, he brings it to his love.
verses.am: and looks upon a lion, and walks in the darkness; and when he has stolen, plundered, and robbed, he brings it to his love.

verses.en: Wherefore a man loves his wife better than father or mother.
verses.am: Wherefore a man loves his wife better than father or mother.

verses.en: Yes, many there be that have run out of their wits for women, and become bondmen for their sakes.
verses.am: Yes, many there be that have run out of their wits for women, and become bondmen for their sakes.

verses.en: Many also have perished, have stumbled, and sinned, for women.
verses.am: Many also have perished, have stumbled, and sinned, for women.

verses.en: And now do you⌃ not believe me? is not the king great in his power? do not all regions fear to touch him?
verses.am: And now do you⌃ not believe me? is not the king great in his power? do not all regions fear to touch him?

verses.en: Yet did I see him and Apame the king’s concubine, the daughter of the illustrious Barticus, sitting at the right hand of the king,
verses.am: Yet did I see him and Apame the king’s concubine, the daughter of the illustrious Barticus, sitting at the right hand of the king,

verses.en: and taking the crown from the king’s head, and setting it upon her own head; yes, she struck the king with her left hand:
verses.am: and taking the crown from the king’s head, and setting it upon her own head; yes, she struck the king with her left hand:

verses.en: and therewithal the king gaped and gazed upon her with open mouth: if she laughed upon him, he laughed also: but if she took any displeasure at him, he was fain to flatter, that she might be reconciled to him again.
verses.am: and therewithal the king gaped and gazed upon her with open mouth: if she laughed upon him, he laughed also: but if she took any displeasure at him, he was fain to flatter, that she might be reconciled to him again.

verses.en: O sirs, how can it be but women should be strong, seeing they do thus?
verses.am: O sirs, how can it be but women should be strong, seeing they do thus?

verses.en: Then the king and the nobles looked one upon another: so he began to speak concerning truth.
verses.am: Then the king and the nobles looked one upon another: so he began to speak concerning truth.

verses.en: O sirs, are not women strong? great is the earth, high is the heaven, swift is the sun in his course, for he encircles the heavens round about, and fetches his course again to his own place in one day.
verses.am: O sirs, are not women strong? great is the earth, high is the heaven, swift is the sun in his course, for he encircles the heavens round about, and fetches his course again to his own place in one day.

verses.en: Is he not great that makes these things? therefore great is truth, and stronger than all things.
verses.am: Is he not great that makes these things? therefore great is truth, and stronger than all things.

verses.en: All the earth calls upon truth, and the heaven blesses her: all works shake and tremble, but with Another reading is, him. her is no unrighteous thing.
verses.am: All the earth calls upon truth, and the heaven blesses her: all works shake and tremble, but with Another reading is, him. her is no unrighteous thing.

verses.en: Wine is unrighteous, the king is unrighteous, women are unrighteous, all the children of men are unrighteous, and unrighteous are all such their works; and there is no truth in them; in their unrighteousness also they shall perish.
verses.am: Wine is unrighteous, the king is unrighteous, women are unrighteous, all the children of men are unrighteous, and unrighteous are all such their works; and there is no truth in them; in their unrighteousness also they shall perish.

verses.en: But truth remains, and is strong forever; she lives and conquers forevermore.
verses.am: But truth remains, and is strong forever; she lives and conquers forevermore.

verses.en: With her there is no accepting of persons or rewards; but she does the things that are just, and refrains from all unrighteous and wicked things; and all men do well like of her works.
verses.am: With her there is no accepting of persons or rewards; but she does the things that are just, and refrains from all unrighteous and wicked things; and all men do well like of her works.

verses.en: Neither in her judgment is any unrighteousness; and she is the strength, and the kingdom, and the power, and the majesty, of all ages. Blessed be the God of truth.
verses.am: Neither in her judgment is any unrighteousness; and she is the strength, and the kingdom, and the power, and the majesty, of all ages. Blessed be the God of truth.

verses.en: And with that he held his tongue. And all the people then shouted, and said, Great is truth, and strong above all things.
verses.am: And with that he held his tongue. And all the people then shouted, and said, Great is truth, and strong above all things.

verses.en: Then said the king to him, Ask what you will more than is appointed in writing, and we will give it you, inasmuch as you are found wisest; and you shall sit next me, and shall be called my cousin.
verses.am: Then said the king to him, Ask what you will more than is appointed in writing, and we will give it you, inasmuch as you are found wisest; and you shall sit next me, and shall be called my cousin.

verses.en: Then said he to the king, Remember your vow, which you did vow to build Jerusalem, in the day when you came to your kingdom,
verses.am: Then said he to the king, Remember your vow, which you did vow to build Jerusalem, in the day when you came to your kingdom,

verses.en: and to send away all the vessels that were taken out of Jerusalem, which Cyrus set apart, when he vowed to destroy Babylon, and vowed to send them again there.
verses.am: and to send away all the vessels that were taken out of Jerusalem, which Cyrus set apart, when he vowed to destroy Babylon, and vowed to send them again there.

verses.en: You did also vow to build up the temple, which the Edomites burned when Judea was made desolate by the Chaldeans.
verses.am: You did also vow to build up the temple, which the Edomites burned when Judea was made desolate by the Chaldeans.

verses.en: And now, O lord the king, this is that which I require, and which I desire of you, and this is the princely generosity that shall proceed from you: I pray therefore that you make good the vow, the performance whereof you have vowed to the King of heaven with your own mouth.
verses.am: And now, O lord the king, this is that which I require, and which I desire of you, and this is the princely generosity that shall proceed from you: I pray therefore that you make good the vow, the performance whereof you have vowed to the King of heaven with your own mouth.

verses.en: Then Darius the king stood up, and kissed him, and wrote letters for him to all the treasurers and governors and captains and satraps, that they should safely bring on their way both him, and all those that should go up with him to build Jerusalem.
verses.am: Then Darius the king stood up, and kissed him, and wrote letters for him to all the treasurers and governors and captains and satraps, that they should safely bring on their way both him, and all those that should go up with him to build Jerusalem.

verses.en: He wrote letters also to all the governors that were in Coelesyria and Phoenicia, and to them in Libanus, that they should bring cedar wood from Libanus to Jerusalem, and that they should build the city with him.
verses.am: He wrote letters also to all the governors that were in Coelesyria and Phoenicia, and to them in Libanus, that they should bring cedar wood from Libanus to Jerusalem, and that they should build the city with him.

verses.en: Moreover he wrote for all the Jews that should go out of his realm up into Jewry, concerning their freedom, that no officer, no governor, no satrap, nor treasurer, should forcibly enter into their doors;
verses.am: Moreover he wrote for all the Jews that should go out of his realm up into Jewry, concerning their freedom, that no officer, no governor, no satrap, nor treasurer, should forcibly enter into their doors;

verses.en: and that all the country which they occupied should be free to them without tribute; and that the Edomites should give over the villages of the Jews which then they held:
verses.am: and that all the country which they occupied should be free to them without tribute; and that the Edomites should give over the villages of the Jews which then they held:

verses.en: and that there should be yearly given twenty talents to the building of the temple, until the time that it were built;
verses.am: and that there should be yearly given twenty talents to the building of the temple, until the time that it were built;

verses.en: and other ten talents yearly, for burnt offerings to be presented upon the altar every day, as they had a commandment to offer seventeen:
verses.am: and other ten talents yearly, for burnt offerings to be presented upon the altar every day, as they had a commandment to offer seventeen:

verses.en: and that all those who should come from Babylonia to build the city should have their freedom, as well they as their posterity, and all the priests that came.
verses.am: and that all those who should come from Babylonia to build the city should have their freedom, as well they as their posterity, and all the priests that came.

verses.en: He wrote also to give them their charges, and the priests’ vestments wherein they minister;
verses.am: He wrote also to give them their charges, and the priests’ vestments wherein they minister;

verses.en: and for the Levites he wrote that their charges should be given them until the day that the house were finished, and Jerusalem built up.
verses.am: and for the Levites he wrote that their charges should be given them until the day that the house were finished, and Jerusalem built up.

verses.en: And he commanded to give to all that kept the city lands and wages.
verses.am: And he commanded to give to all that kept the city lands and wages.

verses.en: He sent away also all the vessels from Babylon, that Cyrus had set apart; and all that Cyrus had given in commandment, the same charged he also to be done, and sent to Jerusalem.
verses.am: He sent away also all the vessels from Babylon, that Cyrus had set apart; and all that Cyrus had given in commandment, the same charged he also to be done, and sent to Jerusalem.

verses.en: Now when this young man was gone forth, he lifted up his face to heaven toward Jerusalem, and praised the King of heaven,
verses.am: Now when this young man was gone forth, he lifted up his face to heaven toward Jerusalem, and praised the King of heaven,

verses.en: and said, From you comes victory, from you comes wisdom, and your is the glory, and I am your servant.
verses.am: and said, From you comes victory, from you comes wisdom, and your is the glory, and I am your servant.

verses.en: Blessed are you, who have given me wisdom: and to you I give thanks, O Lord of our fathers.
verses.am: Blessed are you, who have given me wisdom: and to you I give thanks, O Lord of our fathers.

verses.en: And so he took the letters, and went out, and came to Babylon, and told it all his kindred.
verses.am: And so he took the letters, and went out, and came to Babylon, and told it all his kindred.

verses.en: And they praised the God of their fathers, because he had given them freedom and liberty
verses.am: And they praised the God of their fathers, because he had given them freedom and liberty

verses.en: to go up, and to build Jerusalem, and the temple which is called by his name: and they feasted with instruments of music and gladness seven days.
verses.am: to go up, and to build Jerusalem, and the temple which is called by his name: and they feasted with instruments of music and gladness seven days.

verses.en: After this were the chiefs of fathers’ houses chosen to go up according to their tribes, with their wives and sons and daughters, with their menservants and maidservants, and their cattle.
verses.am: After this were the chiefs of fathers’ houses chosen to go up according to their tribes, with their wives and sons and daughters, with their menservants and maidservants, and their cattle.

verses.en: And Darius sent with them a thousand horsemen, till they had brought them back to Jerusalem Gr. with peace. safely, and with musical instruments, tabrets and flutes.
verses.am: And Darius sent with them a thousand horsemen, till they had brought them back to Jerusalem Gr. with peace. safely, and with musical instruments, tabrets and flutes.

verses.en: And all their kindred played, and he made them go up together with them.
verses.am: And all their kindred played, and he made them go up together with them.

verses.en: And these are the names of the men which went up, according to their families among their tribes, after their several divisions.
verses.am: And these are the names of the men which went up, according to their families among their tribes, after their several divisions.

verses.en: The priests, the sons of Phinees, the sons of Aaron: Jesus the son of Josedek, the son of Saraias, and Joakim the son of Zorobabel, the son of Salathiel, of the house of David, of the lineage of Phares, of the tribe of Judah;
verses.am: The priests, the sons of Phinees, the sons of Aaron: Jesus the son of Josedek, the son of Saraias, and Joakim the son of Zorobabel, the son of Salathiel, of the house of David, of the lineage of Phares, of the tribe of Judah;

verses.en: who spoke wise sentences before Darius the king of Persia in the second year of his reign, in the month Nisan, which is the first month.
verses.am: who spoke wise sentences before Darius the king of Persia in the second year of his reign, in the month Nisan, which is the first month.

verses.en: and to give into the holy treasury of the works a thousand pounds of gold, five thousand of silver, and a hundred priestly vestments.
verses.am: and to give into the holy treasury of the works a thousand pounds of gold, five thousand of silver, and a hundred priestly vestments.

verses.en: And the priests and the Levites and those who were of the people lived in Jerusalem and the country; the holy singers also and the gatekeepers and all Israel in their villages.
verses.am: And the priests and the Levites and those who were of the people lived in Jerusalem and the country; the holy singers also and the gatekeepers and all Israel in their villages.

verses.en: But when the seventh month was at hand, and when the children of Israel were every man in his own place, they came all together with one consent into the broad place before the first porch which is toward the east.
verses.am: But when the seventh month was at hand, and when the children of Israel were every man in his own place, they came all together with one consent into the broad place before the first porch which is toward the east.

verses.en: Then stood up Jesus the son of Josedek, and his kindred the priests, and Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and his kindred, and made ready the altar of the God of Israel,
verses.am: Then stood up Jesus the son of Josedek, and his kindred the priests, and Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and his kindred, and made ready the altar of the God of Israel,

verses.en: to offer burned sacrifices upon it, according as it is expressly commanded in the book of Moses the man of God.
verses.am: to offer burned sacrifices upon it, according as it is expressly commanded in the book of Moses the man of God.

verses.en: And certain were gathered to them out of the other nations of the land, and they erected the altar upon its own place, because all the nations of the land were at enmity with them, and oppressed them; and they offered sacrifices according to the time, and burnt offerings to the Lord both morning and evening.

verses.en: Also they held the feast of tabernacles, as it is commanded in the law, and offered sacrifices daily, as was meet:

verses.en: and after that, the continual oblations, and the sacrifices of the Sabbaths, and of the new moons, and of all the consecrated feasts.
verses.am: and after that, the continual oblations, and the sacrifices of the Sabbaths, and of the new moons, and of all the consecrated feasts.

verses.am: And all those who had made any vow to God began to offer sacrifices to God from the new moon of the Another reading is, first. seventh month, although the temple of God was not yet built.

verses.en: And they gave money to the masons and carpenters; and meat and drink,
verses.am: And they gave money to the masons and carpenters; and meat and drink,

verses.en: and cars to them of Sidon and Tyre, that they should bring cedar trees from Libanus, and convey them in floats to the haven of Joppa, according to the commandment which was written for them by Cyrus king of the Persians.
verses.am: and cars to them of Sidon and Tyre, that they should bring cedar trees from Libanus, and convey them in floats to the haven of Joppa, according to the commandment which was written for them by Cyrus king of the Persians.

verses.en: And in the second year after his coming to the temple of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and Jesus the son of Josedek, and their kindred, and the priests the Levites, and all those who were come to Jerusalem out of the captivity:

verses.en: and they laid the foundation of the temple of God on the new moon of the second month, in the second year after they were come to Jewry and Jerusalem.
verses.am: and they laid the foundation of the temple of God on the new moon of the second month, in the second year after they were come to Jewry and Jerusalem.

So the builders built the temple of the Lord.

verses.en: And the priests stood arrayed in their vestments with musical instruments and trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with their cymbals,

verses.en: singing songs of thanksgiving, and praising the Lord, after the order of David king of Israel.
verses.am: singing songs of thanksgiving, and praising the Lord, after the order of David king of Israel.

verses.en: And they sang aloud, praising the Lord in songs of thanksgiving, because his goodness and his glory are forever in all Israel.
verses.am: And they sang aloud, praising the Lord in songs of thanksgiving, because his goodness and his glory are forever in all Israel.

verses.en: And all the people sounded trumpets, and shouted with a loud voice, singing songs of thanksgiving to the Lord for the rearing up of the house of the Lord.
verses.am: And all the people sounded trumpets, and shouted with a loud voice, singing songs of thanksgiving to the Lord for the rearing up of the house of the Lord.

verses.en: Ezra 3:12, 13. Also of the priests the Levites, and of the heads of their families, the ancients who had seen the former house came to the building of this with lamentation and great weeping.

verses.en: But many with trumpets and joy shouted with loud voice,
verses.am: But many with trumpets and joy shouted with loud voice,

verses.en: insomuch that the people heard not the trumpets for the weeping of the people: for the multitude sounded marvelously, so that it was heard afar off.
verses.am: insomuch that the people heard not the trumpets for the weeping of the people: for the multitude sounded marvelously, so that it was heard afar off.

verses.en: Ezra 4:1, etc. Wherefore when the enemies of the tribe of Judah and Benjamin heard it, they came to know what that noise of trumpets should mean.

verses.en: And they perceived that those who were of the captivity did build the temple to the Lord, the God of Israel.
verses.am: And they perceived that those who were of the captivity did build the temple to the Lord, the God of Israel.

verses.en: So they went to zorobabel and Jesus, and to the chief men of the families, and said to them, we will build together with you.
verses.am: So they went to zorobabel and Jesus, and to the chief men of the families, and said to them, we will build together with you.

verses.en: For we likewise, as you⌃, do obey your Lord, and do sacrifice to him from the days of Another reading is, Asbacaphath. Asbasareth the king of the Assyrians, who brought us hither.

verses.en: Then Zorobabel and Jesus and the chief men of the families of Israel said to them, It is not Another reading is, for us and you. for you to build the house to the Lord our God.
verses.am: Then Zorobabel and Jesus and the chief men of the families of Israel said to them, It is not Another reading is, for us and you. for you to build the house to the Lord our God.

verses.en: We ourselves alone will build to the Lord of Israel, according as Cyrus the king of the Persians has commanded us.
verses.am: We ourselves alone will build to the Lord of Israel, according as Cyrus the king of the Persians has commanded us.

verses.en: But the heathen of the land lying heavy upon the inhabitants of Judea, and Or, besieging them holding them strait, hindered their building;
verses.am: But the heathen of the land lying heavy upon the inhabitants of Judea, and Or, besieging them holding them strait, hindered their building;

verses.en: and Another reading is, leading the people astray in counsel, and raising commotions. by their secret plots, and popular persuasions and commotions, they hindered the finishing of the building all the time that King Cyrus lived: so they were hindered from building for the space of two years, until the reign of Darius.
verses.am: and Another reading is, leading the people astray in counsel, and raising commotions. by their secret plots, and popular persuasions and commotions, they hindered the finishing of the building all the time that King Cyrus lived: so they were hindered from building for the space of two years, until the reign of Darius.

verses.en: Now Ezra 4:24 and 5:1, etc. in the second year of the reign of Darius, Aggaeus and Zacharius the son of Iddo. Another reading is, Eddin Addo, the prophets, prophesied to the Jews in Jewry and Jerusalem; in the name of the Lord, the God of Israel, prophesied they to them.

verses.en: Then stood up Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and Jesus the son of Josedek, and began to build the house of the Lord at Jerusalem, the prophets of the Lord being with them, and helping them.
verses.am: Then stood up Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and Jesus the son of Josedek, and began to build the house of the Lord at Jerusalem, the prophets of the Lord being with them, and helping them.

verses.en: Ezra 5:3. At the same time came to them Tattenai. Sisinnes the governor of Syria and Phoenicia, with Shetharbozenai Sathrabuzanes and his companions, and said to them,

verses.en: By whose appointment do you⌃ build this house and this roof, and perform all the other things? and who are the builders that perform these things?
verses.am: By whose appointment do you⌃ build this house and this roof, and perform all the other things? and who are the builders that perform these things?

verses.en: Nevertheless the elders of the Jews obtained favor, because the Lord had visited the captivity;
verses.am: Nevertheless the elders of the Jews obtained favor, because the Lord had visited the captivity;

verses.en: and they were not hindered from building, until such time as communication was made to Darius concerning them, and his answer signified.
verses.am: and they were not hindered from building, until such time as communication was made to Darius concerning them, and his answer signified.

verses.en: The copy of the letter which Sisinnes, governor of Syria and Phoenicia, and Sathrabuzanes, with their companions, the rulers in Syria and Phoenicia, wrote and sent to Darius;
verses.am: The copy of the letter which Sisinnes, governor of Syria and Phoenicia, and Sathrabuzanes, with their companions, the rulers in Syria and Phoenicia, wrote and sent to Darius;

verses.en: To king Darius, greeting: Let all things be known to our lord the king, that being come into the country of Judea, and entered into the city of Jerusalem, we found in the city of Jerusalem the elders of the Jews that were of the captivity
verses.am: To king Darius, greeting: Let all things be known to our lord the king, that being come into the country of Judea, and entered into the city of Jerusalem, we found in the city of Jerusalem the elders of the Jews that were of the captivity

verses.en: building a house to the Lord, great and new, of hewn and costly stones, with timber laid in the walls.
verses.am: building a house to the Lord, great and new, of hewn and costly stones, with timber laid in the walls.

verses.en: And those works are done with great speed, and the work goes on prosperously in their hands, and with all glory and diligence it is accomplished.
verses.am: And those works are done with great speed, and the work goes on prosperously in their hands, and with all glory and diligence it is accomplished.

verses.en: Then asked we these elders, saying, By whose commandment build you⌃ this house, and lay the foundations of these works?
verses.am: Then asked we these elders, saying, By whose commandment build you⌃ this house, and lay the foundations of these works?

verses.en: Therefore, to the intent that we might give knowledge to you by writing who were the chief doers, we questioned them, and we required of them the names in writing of their principal men.
verses.am: Therefore, to the intent that we might give knowledge to you by writing who were the chief doers, we questioned them, and we required of them the names in writing of their principal men.

verses.en: So they gave us this answer, We are the servants of the Lord which made heaven and earth.
verses.am: So they gave us this answer, We are the servants of the Lord which made heaven and earth.

verses.en: And as for this house, it was built many years ago by a king of Israel great and strong, and was finished.
verses.am: And as for this house, it was built many years ago by a king of Israel great and strong, and was finished.

verses.en: But when our fathers sinned against the Lord of Israel which is in heaven, and provoked him to wrath, he gave them over into the hands of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, king of the Chaldeans;
verses.am: But when our fathers sinned against the Lord of Israel which is in heaven, and provoked him to wrath, he gave them over into the hands of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, king of the Chaldeans;

verses.en: and they pulled down the house, and burned it, and carried away the people captives to Babylon.
verses.am: and they pulled down the house, and burned it, and carried away the people captives to Babylon.

verses.en: But in the first year that Cyrus reigned over the country of Babylon, king Cyrus wrote to build up this house.
verses.am: But in the first year that Cyrus reigned over the country of Babylon, king Cyrus wrote to build up this house.

verses.en: Then Sanabassarus, being come here, laid the foundations of the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem; and from that time to this being still a building, it is not yet fully ended.
verses.am: Then Sanabassarus, being come here, laid the foundations of the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem; and from that time to this being still a building, it is not yet fully ended.

verses.en: Now therefore, if it seem good, O king, let search be made among the royal archives of our lord the king that are in Babylon:
verses.am: Now therefore, if it seem good, O king, let search be made among the royal archives of our lord the king that are in Babylon:

verses.en: and if it be found that the building of the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem has been done with the consent of king Cyrus, and it seem good to our lord the king, let him signify to us thereof.
